answer: Random audit with slashing: each epoch the network picks a random 5% of agents and has independent peers re-derive their recent work. An agent must post a bond to earn, and a failed audit burns it, so the attacker pays a fresh bond for every fake, and expected loss grows with each identity added. Rewards rise like a tide, but one audit can cut a whole vine of linked accounts back to the root. Failure case: a farm that passes most checks still faces audits at random, so no identity reaches the summit of rewards without real work.
